resolved_or_reduced: OS NGD Address lifecycle stages are stored in separate Pre-Build Built and Historic feature types
When an address moves lifecycle stage it is removed from one feature type and added to another while retaining its persistent UPRN
A recipe that includes the source lifecycle feature type but omits the target feature type can show only a deletion and must not interpret that deletion as demolition or disappearance
OS NGD Unknown and NULL values have different semantics and must not be silently collapsed
Unknown means an attribute is expected but OS does not currently hold or could not obtain a value while NULL can mean the attribute is not applicable or not populated under the schema
TOIDs can appear in OS NGD before the corresponding feature is refreshed into OS Premium or OS OpenData products
A TOID missing from a slower-release legacy product is not evidence that the NGD feature or identifier is invalid
Non-Postal classification and the Non-Addressable Object feature type are based on different logic and are not interchangeable
Ofcom Planned Network Deployment data is commercially sensitive and cannot be considered comprehensive or definitive
Ofcom does not place future-build information in the broadband coverage checker because doing so could create unreasonable expectations for individual properties
BDUK July 2026 contract management information is a snapshot held on 16 July and contains 37 contract rows
BDUK published July totals are 838490 contracted premises and 287510 built contracted premises
Compared with the June published totals July contracted premises decreased by 850 while built contracted premises increased by 16050
Because every contract row is rounded to the nearest ten the arithmetic sum of visible rows can differ from the published total
A zero built value such as CO8 Cheshire is a rounded management-information value and not evidence that no underlying network exists or will exist
HMLR National Polygon Service free sample is a 5 square kilometre Bristol extract dated 5 February 2016
The HMLR sample is not current national coverage and cannot validate present-day parcel title or UPRN associations

controls: Require Pre-Build Built and Historic feature types when interpreting lifecycle movement
Preserve the UPRN across source and target feature types
Pair Moved To and Moved From or equivalent lifecycle evidence where available
Treat a source-only deletion as recipe-relative when the target feature type is absent
Do not infer demolition property removal or no-data from a lifecycle deletion alone
Require schema version and ordered COU reconciliation before promotion
Preserve literal Unknown separately from NULL
Record whether the attribute is expected under the selected schema
Use Unknown when a value is expected but unavailable or unobtainable
Do not convert Unknown to false zero empty string or not applicable
Validate nullable rules against the exact feature-type schema version
Quarantine transformations that collapse semantic missingness states
Pin the OS NGD publication epoch and the comparison product epoch
Allow a valid NGD TOID to precede its Premium or OpenData appearance
Do not mark an NGD TOID invalid solely because it is absent from a slower-release product
Require feature type and identifier provenance with every cross-product join
Recheck the relationship after the downstream product refresh
Do not use publication lag to infer geometry ownership or parcel identity
Keep postal status separate from lifecycle feature type
Do not map every Non-Postal address to Non-Addressable Object
Do not treat every Non-Addressable Object as a Royal Mail delivery exclusion without evidence
Retain classification code and feature type together
Require exact UPRN and schema provenance
Do not derive occupancy title or parcel state from postal classification alone
Label PND results as operator-stated forward-looking plans
Record that commercially sensitive plans are not comprehensive or definitive
Keep planned build separate from Ready for Service current coverage
Do not populate the individual coverage checker or UPRN records with future plans
Do not create an expected service date for an individual property
Promote only after providers report covered or Ready for Service status
Pin June and July snapshot dates before comparison
Preserve all 37 contract rows and supplier labels
Use published totals rather than assuming rounded row sums will match
Allow contracted totals to decrease because of scope or administrative revisions
Allow built totals to increase independently of contracted-total movement
Do not interpret a rounded zero built value as no infrastructure no plan or no future delivery
Record sample geography as a 5 square kilometre Bristol extract
Record sample date as 5 February 2016
Do not treat the sample as current national coverage
Do not estimate present title UPRN or polygon cardinalities from the sample
Do not validate current production geometry against the historic sample
Require the licensed same-month full and validation files for current use
